Method of Attack: Creating and gifting a malicious NFT containing an SVG image with embedded malicious JavaScript code and an iFrame that injects 'window.ethereum' to trigger wallet connection requests
Abusing Ethereum RPC-API to open pop-ups for wallet connection and signature requests to hijack user wallets
Luring victims to click on malicious NFT art that triggers unexpected wallet sign-in and signature pop-ups
Impacted Systems: OpenSea platform users with third-party cryptocurrency wallets, especially MetaMask
Attack Vector: Malicious NFT art gifted via OpenSea marketplace (airdropping)
User interaction with malicious SVG image triggering wallet connection and signature pop-ups
Indicators of Compromise: Unexpected wallet sign-in requests after viewing gifted NFTs
Malicious SVG images containing JavaScript and iFrame elements
